release_notes:
fix: admin/client data-integrity bugs + full mobile-responsive pass on admin profile & services pages

Data integrity & correctness
- code.php: rejecting/completing/resubmitting an IMEI order never cleared
  ManualVerifyStatus/RejectReviewStatus, so a resolved order stayed stuck on
  the admin "Under Verification" / "Reject Review" lists forever. Now cleared
  whenever an admin submits a decision.
- credithistory.php (client + admin), shop-orders.php: records=0 from the
  page-size dropdown was passed straight into SQL LIMIT, returning zero rows
  instead of the default page size.
- credithistory.php: utf8mb3/utf8mb4 collation mismatch in the CodeId
  subquery crashed the whole query silently, showing an empty statement.
- cd14db.class.php / 111cd14db.class.php: DB connection used SET NAMES
  'utf8' (3-byte utf8mb3), silently corrupting 4-byte emoji from supplier
  API replies into "?" on save.
- functions.php: #CART# and #VIDEO_LINK# email placeholders were filled with
  a bare <tr> outside any <table> — invalid HTML that made Gmail collapse
  the whole email into a narrow left column.
- ticket.php: admin replying to a ticket auto-closed it; now only an
  explicit close action does.

Mobile responsiveness (admin + client)
- Client "My Statement" (crhistory_gf.php): search filter now collapsed by
  default (was the only one on the site defaulting open); results table
  converts to stacked cards on phones instead of bleeding off-screen.
- Client hamburger menu + admin sidebar drawer: rows tightened, panel height
  capped with internal scroll instead of taking over the whole screen.
- Admin client-profile page (overview.php + tabs): dropped a redundant
  placeholder-avatar block that duplicated the identity info already shown;
  action toolbar reflows into a proper card grid instead of Bootstrap's
  fused button-group wrapping unevenly across rows; "Back To List" no longer
  reads as part of that button grid; Invoices tab's fixed-height scrollers
  no longer leave a wall of empty space for 1-2 line items; Blocked IPs and
  Top Services tables wrapped in .table-responsive instead of clipping.
- services.php / serverservices.php: same toolbar-grid treatment; fixed a
  pre-existing bug where these pages' entire button/filter section scrolled
  horizontally together with the data table (a stray .table-responsive
  wrapper spanned everything) — only the table scrolls now.

All changes verified against real data at mobile/tablet/desktop widths;
desktop layout confirmed pixel-unchanged throughout.
